description: Repo hygiene for T1 item 10. local_only checks need the verification toolchain; the signoff.yml runner skips them under --check. Supersedes manifests/item10-inventory-5.json and its attestation manifests/item10-attestation-5.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which hashed verification/README.md and .github/workflows/rtl-ci.yml before issue #90 moved the generated-RTL exactness check out of rtl/gen/tests/test_gen.py: the loose-tolerance smoke was replaced by verification/test_gen_exact.py (bit-exact vs the fixed-point model at six configurations), wired into rtl-ci.yml as the gen-exact / gen-exact-negctl make targets, and those two checks join this inventory so the new bit-exactness evidence is attested. The same hygiene entries are carried unchanged; the previous checks are carried unchanged. -5 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-4.json and manifests/item10-attestation-4.json, which hashed README.md and .github/workflows/signoff.yml before issue #79 fixed that Reproduce row (it still named the by-then-superseded -3) and repointed the workflow's re-attest step; -5 carried the same checks and hygiene entries. -4 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-3.json / manifests/item10-attestation-3.json, which hashed README.md before the status alignment of issue #62. -3 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-2.json / manifests/item10-attestation-2.json, whose checks (lint, sim, negctl) and hygiene entry measurements/synth-placeholder.json cover the retired placeholder flow. measurements/synth-placeholder.json is retained as history; the live synthesis record is measurements/fft256-smoke.json.
